findings.summary: The inner merge on customer_id double-counts orders (overstating revenue_cents) if segments has multiple rows per customer.

judge.reason: Describes join on customer_id duplicating orders when multiple segment rows per customer, overstating revenue.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The inner merge silently drops orders from customers with no row in segments, so segment totals won't sum to total revenue.

judge.reason: Inner join dropping orders without segment rows is a known other problem, not the duplication bug.

findings.label: valid_other
